# SVG Repo sources — vendored for audit

These SVGs are **import inputs**, not shipped resources: `vendor/` is excluded from the npm
package `files` list. The illustrations derived from them ship under `resources/illustrations/`
(`cherry`, `watermelon`, `apple`, `strawberry`, `ice-cream`, `avocado`, `chick`, `flower`,
`love-birds` and `electrocardiogram`), converted with `tools/import-svg-asset.mjs`.
